question: In the D3 open-loop setting, is the post-tilt ON command change that topples an OFF-posture body effective through its direction (sign and pattern) or only through its size, and do the post-tilt commands of ON arms that stayed up also topple it?
not_claimed: physiological validity of POST_NEG or POST_SCRAMBLE

sources.code_reused: jo_command_yoke Trial (apply/capture/detach), yoke_audit, gravity_ok, outcome (45 deg rule), first_qpos_difference; coxa_offset_yoke.schedule; jo_zone_crossing.Trial context; unchanged

context: As D3: Step D trial OFF_DOWN20_s (JO withheld; gravity R_y(-20 deg) after stored state 5005), CNS seed s of the source; all 42 applied coordinates from the declared schedule; adhesion all zero (the run errors otherwise)

schedule.transitions_0_5004: all 42 coordinates from the OFF archive

transitions_5005_19999_admitted.POST_ONLY: ON archive values directly (no arithmetic, no clip)
transitions_5005_19999_admitted.POST_SCRAMBLE: sign +1: ON archive values directly; sign -1: clip(OFF - (ON - OFF))

schedule.clip: to joint_range_rad; clipped value count reported per arm, not a gate

arms.name: <CONDITION>__<SOURCE>
arms.order: fallen sources in the order above with conditions in the order above, then upright sources in the order above
arms.duration: 20000 physics / 4000 neural transitions each; fresh process each; run once

measures.fall: D3 rule: tilt (antennal_gravity_live.body_angles[0]) >= 45 deg at any stored state 5006-20000 -> FALLS, else STAYS_UP
measures.also_reported: peak tilt after state 5005; clipped value count; largest per-transition change of any applied coordinate (including the step at the tilt); mean |ON - OFF| over admitted coordinates and transitions 5005-19999 per source

labels.consistency: within G1 (3 fallen sources) and within FLIP (2) separately: CONSISTENT if identical for every source, else MIXED; no pooling
labels.upright: DEGENERATE if the ON and OFF archives' qpos are equal at every stored state 0-5005 (first difference None or > 5005); else the POST_ONLY outcome counts; report per assignment the number of non-degenerate upright arms that fall, with each arm listed

integrity.Z1_complete: all 27 arms COMPLETE with 20001 samples and 4000 ticks
integrity.Z2_reproduction: each fallen-source POST_ONLY arm's qpos equals the D3 POST_ONLY arm's qpos at every stored state exactly
integrity.Z3_yoke_audit: every arm's recorded commanded_joints at state n+1 equals the declared schedule row n exactly for n = 0..19999; adhesion recorded all zero
integrity.Z4_gravity: recorded gravity (0,0,-9810) for states 0-5005 and exactly R_y(-20 deg) @ (0,0,-9810) from 5006; no applied body wrench; zero external and generalized applied maxima
integrity.Z5_sources: the Step D and D3 reports, the 18 archives and the 5 D3 POST_ONLY arms equal the sha256 values above; each arm records its source and cns_seed

design_expectations.E1: POST_NEG STAYS_UP in at least 4 of 5 fallen sources
design_expectations.E2: POST_HALF STAYS_UP in all 5 fallen sources
design_expectations.E3: no non-degenerate upright POST_ONLY arm falls
design_expectations.recording: each HELD or NOT_HELD; evaluated only when INTEGRITY_ACCEPTED

declared_interpretation.DIRECTION_SPECIFIC_and_PATTERN_SPECIFIC_: the fallen arms' JO-driven post-tilt change has a specific destabilising direction in this open loop
declared_interpretation.DIRECTION_NONSPECIFIC: a change of that size topples the body in either direction; the falls say nothing about the sign of the JO response
declared_interpretation.upright_controls_fall: post-tilt commands of arms that stayed up also topple an OFF-posture body; in closed loop something else kept those arms up

interpretation_limits: Open loop: the mixed streams never occurred in a closed loop.
POST_NEG and POST_SCRAMBLE are not physiological; they probe the body's response to the size and direction of a command change.
One scramble vector: a single sample of another direction.
Clipping can shrink a reversed change; every POST condition steps the commands at the gravity step; reversed changes can exceed the decoder slew limit. Both are reported.
Five fallen and seven upright sources; labels per source, no statistics.
Step D limits apply (idealised gravity step, modelled JO transduction).
No motor coordinate status change (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
single_run: All 27 arms run once after protocol, code and tests are committed and pushed; evaluated once.
